LESSON: PEACEFUL COEXISTENCE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 2.6: Peaceful Coexistence

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Peaceful Coexistence
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we promote peace for mutual social well-being?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the meaning of key terms used in community service learning (CSL) and CSL projects
2. describe the importance of CSL in the community

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain the meaning of key terms used in community service learning (CSL) and CSL projects

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain the meaning of key terms used in community service learning (CSL) and CSL projects.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain the meaning of key terms used in community service learning (CSL) and CSL projects” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain the meaning of key terms used in community service learning (CSL) and CSL projects” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain the meaning of key terms used in community service learning (CSL) and CSL projects" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: describe the importance of CSL in the community

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the importance of CSL in the community.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe the importance of CSL in the community” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the importance of CSL in the community” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the importance of CSL in the community" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain the meaning of key terms used in community service learning (CSL) and CSL projects
• Model 2: describe the importance of CSL in the community

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain the meaning of key terms used in community service learning (CSL) and CSL projects
2. Practise: describe the importance of CSL in the community

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Peaceful Coexistence.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we promote peace for mutual social well-being?
2. How can I manage stress and emotion to promote inner peace?
3. How can community service learning contribute to community development?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the meaning of key terms used in community service learning (CSL) and CSL projects
• describe the importance of CSL in the community

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
